caption: The drawing features three elongated metal objects, each with distinct shapes at their ends, laid horizontally and parallel to each other on a light beige background. All three objects appear to be dark in color, with tones of black and brown giving them a weathered, metallic look. The top object has a hooked handle on one end and a complex, multi-pronged shape on the other end. The middle object features a simple looped handle and a large arrowhead-like shape at the opposite end. The bottom object has a similar looped handle but ends in a triangular form with an inner angular structure. Below the objects, there are three symbols inside square boxes; from left to right, the symbols are a four-armed spiral, a capital Greek letter sigma (Σ), and a triangle (Δ), all depicted in black outline. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the objects evenly spaced across the page.
title: Branding Iron
